summary: Backend-only testing of Veronica's Dream Wedding API. All 15 pytest tests passed covering health, project singleton CRUD, dream categories/goals, vendor CRUD, vendor service CRUD, selection total computation (per_guest and fixed), task CRUD + status transitions, dashboard aggregation, and seed idempotency/reset. Verified critical business logic: per_guest EUR 80 * 50 guests = 4000, fixed EUR 1300 * 1 = 1300, and total recalculation on guest_count change (80 * 60 = 4800). No _id leakage observed.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/seed?reset=true is publicly exposed and wipes vendors/tasks/selections/project without confirmation. For a private app it's acceptable, but consider a confirmation token for safety.

seed reset=true also deletes the project singleton, so any custom guest_count/target_budget/couple_names/wedding_date the user has set will be lost. Consider preserving the project on reset or documenting this behaviour.

compute_total uses the snapshotted unit_price/price_type stored on the selection (good). However, if the underlying vendor service's unit_price is edited later, existing selections will NOT auto-update. This is likely desired snapshot behaviour but should be documented.
update_service endpoint uses VendorServiceCreate which requires all fields, so it is effectively a full replace, not a PATCH. Non-blocking.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan handlers for future-proofing.
Dashboard returns 'tasks_todo/tasks_progress/tasks_done' keys which were not in the feature list but are useful additions; harmless.
CORS is wide-open ('*') by default — fine for a private single-user app but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Did not inject seed data manually — backend auto-seeds on first boot and via /api/seed. The final test calls /api/seed?reset=true which leaves DB in clean seeded state (6 vendors, 10 tasks, default project with guest_count=50, target_budget=15000, couple_names='Veronica & You', wedding_date=None).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract fully passing. Seed reset wipes user project customisations — so after running the test suite, project.wedding_date is None and guest_count=50. Frontend testing can begin. Test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_wedding_backend.py, JUnit XML at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml.
